features.title: Everything between soil and sale.
features.body: One place to be discovered, win new buyers, get paid safely and grow a reputation that travels further than your produce.
features.oneDesc: Turn every harvest into a beautiful storefront. Add products, prices, availability and the story behind your farm.
features.twoDesc: Share harvest updates, short videos and live showcases that buyers can shop directly.
features.threeDesc: See active requests from hotels, shops and exporters—then send a competitive bid in minutes.
features.fourDesc: Funds are held securely until delivery is confirmed. If something goes wrong, our support team steps in to review and resolve the dispute — neither side is left to sort it out alone.
features.bannerAlt: Two Black African farmers smiling as they prepare market-ready vegetables together
features.bannerQuote: A stronger market starts when farmers are visible, trusted and directly connected to demand.
features.alwaysOpenSub: Your storefront works around the clock
features.escrowSub: Funds are held until delivery is confirmed

buyers.title: Buy what’s available—or post what you need.
buyers.body: Shop available produce directly from farmers, or publish a buyer request and let qualified suppliers come to you. Either way, eMazao takes you from discovery to delivery in one place.
buyers.oneText: Browse produce that is available now, compare suppliers and place an order directly with the right farmer.
buyers.twoTitle: Or let farmers come to you
buyers.twoText: Post the crop, quantity and delivery details you need, then receive offers from farmers ready to supply it.
buyers.threeText: Compare verified profiles, talk directly and use escrow-protected payments from agreement through delivery.
buyers.imageAlt: Produce buyer smiling as he reviews an eMazao order beside a fresh delivery
buyers.orderConfirmedShort: The right produce. The right supplier.
buyers.orderConfirmedLong: The right produce. The right supplier. No guesswork.

how.body: Farmers and buyers move through one connected experience—from discovery and conversation to delivery and protected payment.
how.oneDesc: Farmers share listings, harvest updates, reels and live showcases. Buyers browse supply or publish exactly what they need.
how.twoDesc: Start a direct conversation, request a quote, respond to demand or order from produce attached to content.
how.threeDesc: Confirm the agreement, follow delivery, release protected payment and build a reputation both sides can trust. If anything goes wrong, raise a dispute and our team helps put it right.

requests.body: Buyer-request examples show how businesses publish demand, compare offers and find dependable supply.
